entries.name: Strange fountain
entries.description: Murky or bioluminescent water trickles from a carved basin.

entries.name: Ancient statue
entries.description: A weather-worn stone effigy holding an outstretched bowl or broken implement.

entries.name: Sealed chest
entries.description: An iron-banded timber coffer secured with a heavy, rusted padlock.

entries.name: Peculiar altar
entries.description: A slab of polished obsidian or carved granite bearing dark stains and runic grooves.

entries.name: Inscribed stone
entries.description: A freestanding stele covered in weathered pictograms and ancient script.

entries.name: Strange mirror
entries.description: A tarnished silvered glass that distorts reflections or hints at delayed movement.

entries.name: Pile of bones
entries.description: A heaped mound of calcified skeletal remains arranged in an intentional pattern.

entries.name: Ancient mechanism
entries.description: Interlocking bronze cogs and counterweights mounted against a wall recess.

entries.name: Decorated sarcophagus
entries.description: An ornate stone casket featuring gold-leaf filigree and carved guardian faces.

entries.name: Mysterious pool
entries.description: A tranquil, mirror-flat basin of unknown depth with an unearthly sheen.

entries.name: Sealed cabinet
entries.description: A warped wooden armoire held shut by heavy lead sealing rivets.

entries.name: Unidentified relic
entries.description: A curious artifact of brass, crystal, or bone that hums softly when approached.
